facts.text: Sarah, stay close and keep moving. Nobody is eating in here tonight.
facts.why: Kyle Reese never says this. His line to Sarah at Tech Noir is 'Come with me if you want to live.' The menu line is invented.
facts.fix: Come with me if you want to live.

facts.text: Sarah's diner, ketchup bottle on every table.
facts.why: Big Jeff's is Sarah's workplace, but the sources do not describe ketchup bottles on tables. It is a made up detail about a real place.
facts.fix: Sarah's diner, where she is late for her shift.

facts.text: The pie case at Sarah's diner.
facts.why: Big Jeff's is the diner, but no source mentions a pie case or cherry pie. Made up detail about a real place.
facts.fix: Sarah's diner, where she works a Friday shift.

vibe.verdict: Neon Tech Noir looks great and the venue is right, but the food notes lean on made up diner details and skip the big moments.
